title: Simplify follow endpoint
bug: Following someone twice answers 204 instead of 409.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR description doesn't announce this change. The diff removes the explicit 409 abort when user.is_following(followed_user) is true, relying on User.follow to silently ignore duplicates and return 204.

suspicions.claim: The follow endpoint no longer returns 409 Conflict when the user already follows the target, instead returning 204 No Content silently.
suspicions.trigger: 1. Create two users A and B. 2. Log in as A (POST /api/tokens with basic auth). 3. Follow B (POST /api/me/following/<B_id>) -> expect 204. 4. Repeat the same follow request -> before PR: 409 with error body; after PR: 204 with empty body. Read status code and response body.
suspicions.evidence: Probes 'probe s1: normal_user', 'probe_s1', and 'probe_s2' all sent duplicate POST /api/me/following/2 requests where base returned 409 with error body and head returned 204 with empty body.

suspicions.claim: The follow endpoint no longer returns an error response body (code, message, description) on duplicate follow, breaking clients that parse the 409 error structure.
suspicions.trigger: Same steps as s1. On the second follow request, read the response body: before PR it is a JSON error object with code/message/description; after PR it is an empty object {}.
suspicions.evidence: Probes 'probe s1: normal_user', 'probe_s1', and 'probe_s2' all sent duplicate POST /api/me/following/2 requests where base returned 409 with JSON error object containing code and description, while head returned 204 with null/empty body.
